title: Cross-repo correlation — feature design
summary: Design for a cross-repo correlation capability in sec-overlay: correlation workspace, cross-repo edge model, contract-consistency checks, dedupe, and report.
notes: Status field reads 'design' (draft), not an accepted decision, so not ADR/locked. Dominant signals are implementation contracts: edge data model {type, from, to, evidence, confidence}, CLI sketch, deterministic join keys, output artifacts -> SPEC. Path 'docs/plans/' hints DOC/plan, hence medium confidence. cross_refs are filename mentions, not resolvable links.
